answer: Rotating assignment lottery. Each epoch a public random beacon seeds a deterministic permutation that assigns agents to verification voyages they cannot predict or select in advance. An identity caught hollow—no completed voyage—is excluded from the next draw, so the attacker must fund every identity through unpredictable work rather than a one-time fee. The lotus rule: only identities that finish their assigned check enter the reward pool, costing the attacker the full per-identity verification cost each epoch.
